nodes.label: Top-4 MFCC Features vs SyncD/SyncC Scatter
nodes.description: Scatter plots (n=447) of top-4 features (mfcc_3_std, mfcc_10_mean, mfcc_11_mean, mfcc_7_std) vs SyncD (top row, lower=better) and SyncC (bottom row, higher=better). All four significantly correlated with SyncD (r=-0.336 to -0.201). Mixed direction with SyncC; mfcc_7_std not significant for SyncC (p=0.111).

metadata.finding: MFCC features significantly correlate with SyncD; SyncD and SyncC capture distinct dimensions of lip-sync quality
